description: Meet travellers, expats and locals and enjoy Rome's nightlife. Starting off at Highlander Pub at 10pm with 1 drink of choice+1 shot of choice then heading to some more bars on the road while discovering the pitoresque streets of the Eternal City. Free entry+ welcome shot and drinking games at each venue.
hostdescription:
Hey there!!
Truly in love with my hometown, and having that travel-bug myself I love bringing travellers together to share some unforgettable moments.

reviews.text: It was a great experience! Perfect for solo travelers who wanted to meet new friends from different parts of the world! Alessandro was a great host. He makes sure no one gets left behind. 🍻
Great experience! Alessandro is super personable and charming. He connected people from all over the world and it was a great time. I would definitely recommend if you’re a solo traveler!
Host was a real homie and made sure everyone was taken care of. Took us to some great places, made some new friends and had a great time!

Great for solo travelers like myself! I booked super last minute and had a great time meeting new people. Alessandro is awesome and makes sure everybody stays together for the whole trip. Definitely book!
I would recommend this to anyone who wants ta have a good time and meet other people from all over the world. Alessandro was an excellent host and he makes everyone feel comfortable and welcomed.

It's definitely a great experience if you're traveling alone, you know people from many places, Alessandro is an excellent host, the places have a great atmosphere, without a doubt if you're looking for fun and to meet people, this experience is the best option

People, they should just call this a Bar Crawl. This is exactly what it is from start to Finish. Soon as you walk into Highlander, you are in it! Alessandro does a great job at identifying who's in the group when you walk into the bar. Open bar to start absolutely starts us off on a good not. All the bars were popular and busy. Obtained our complimentary drink son as we got to the new bars. Was with a great group of people from all over the world. Each bar, except the last one we had space to stay within the group. The last one was very very busy. All in all a great experience that connects people and let loose a little.

Alessandro is a host like no other, this pub crawl made our trip and we will happily be going on another one of his excursions when we come back !! Gave us awesome recommendations for places to eat and spots to check our … genuinely don’t you dare miss out on this experience

I went by myself and ended up with new friends both on the tour and outside of it. The host made me feel very welcome and integrated even though I was alone, even at the end of the night I ended up with Italian friends

The clubs are good to join the group, the last one is where there was really fun that you can decide to finish 1-2 am or follow it even until 4 am

Such an amazing way to see Rome at night. Alessandro is incredibly friendly and passionate about making sure you have a great experience whether you come solo or with others. Our group had about 15 people from all over the world. We walked from pub to pub to club, danced, played games and met some amazing people who I can actually call friends. If you want to have some fun in Rome, book this crawl. You won’t regret it.

Great time. Alessandro knows how to bring people together… What I personally valued most was that you’re able to meet people from all over the world… Pretty fun actually. Actually met people who chose to join Alessandro for a second night of good times.

My friends and I enjoyed this bar crawl very much! We were able to go to multiple bars which were all very different. It was also great to be able to walk past many landmarks at night. We highly recommend booking with Alessandro as he was a fun host!

My husband and I were looking for something to do last minute for our last night in Rome and I seen Alessandro's bar crawl so we booked the night before and I am so glad we did! It was a great way to meet new people and get us out of our comfort zone all while having a really fun time. The environment was very welcoming and felt safe. We had a friendly group of people with us and Alessandro made sure everyone was having a good time!

Alessandro is very kind and welcoming! Because I was a solo traveller, I was really nervous I would not connect with anyone. As soon as I came in, he made sure I got my drink (you get a free shot and a free drink ticket) and connected me with other people that were there. The places we visited were a vibe, you could either dance or you could sit and just chat with your friends. I liked the high energy from the host. I would recommend this if you are solo, or you are in a group but you want a little taste of Rome nightlife - but you are unsure of where to go.

Alessandro also sent me a list of places I should visit in Rome and it was sweet <3.

Definitely was a fun time and you can tell Alessandro really cares about your experience and makes it easy to relax and have fun. Would definitely recommend to anyone trying to meet new people and gain new experiences

Such a fun time. I was solo traveling and this was the perfect way to actually get into the nightlife and not feel alone. Alessandro is so entertaining and we played a ton of fun drinking games that brought us together really well. 6/5 stars and I’m definitely doing this again.
This experience was definitely a super fun way to experience Rome and meet new friends! Alessandro and Daniela were both awesome and our group had a great time!

I'm sorry, but all in all we had way too little time to get to know the other tour guests in the first two bars.

The third and last bar was basically a overcrowded Club which not only killed the mood in a personal manner since some of the guests left pretty soon after, but it was also amongst the most overpriced places I have been to so far in Rome.

The tour guide Alessandro was very nice though.

A great experience and a fun filled way to make new friends and memories! Alessandro really goes out of his way to make everyone feel welcome and comfortable - one of the best hosts I have come across! Definitely check this bar crawl out, especially if you’re travelling alone to Rome!

A really great social bars crew!!
good bars and clubs visiting theme in Rome and the most important good people's
they good cool thinks for connecting betweens us and rely it was good experience

thank you! very recommend!!!

Yo! If you happen to be in Rome, want to have a great time, meet some cool people, and enjoy some of the nightlife that the city has to offer then look no further. Drinks, food, and a great atmosphere is what to be expected.

Alessandro was a fantastic host! You felt welcomed right as you enter the door and throughout the night.

What a great time in the city! Last minute or book a week before, THIS IS A MUST! More on the younger side, this is great for groups, couples and especially solo travelers! So much fun, even if you don’t drink you can make some friends and have a good time. Alessandro was so kind, great at communicating and making sure you were okay. Checking in at all the spots he took you too. It was my birthday and I almost didn’t want to go out because I was so jet lagged, so glad I did! I was treated special and had a total blast! Go do it, I promise you’ll have so much fun and make some awesome friends.
Had too much fun to the point I was struggling the next day lol. Great way to meet people traveling from all over and Alessandro was a fantastic host and made sure everyone was having a great time.

I booked it one hour before the Crawl started and one of the best made decision right after landing in Rome 🙃 . He made sure that everyone was ok , met wonderful person , if it wasn't for my next flight , would have booked it again for sure before going

This is probably my first ever review on airbnb…and I myself was willing to write it. First and foremost, Alessandro is a cool guy. He welcomes you, and he makes sure you are in the group and feeling well. You feel cool as soon as you see him. But the most important thing here is the people who joins this tour. They all want the same thing. Connections and a fun night. I guess the experience could really depend on the group and who is in it, but wow my experience was terrific!!! It was so much fun and even after our guide left, we still hung out together for a short period of time. It’s really all about how you approach it. I am an introvert, but sometimes you seek discomfort to make memories of your lifetime. If you are willing to do so, it will be the night of your life. Have fun and enjoy it! Rome night life isnt soooo exciting but you can make it fun! I will remember this night for a very long time. Thank you!

My girlfriend and I had a great time, we planed staying for 2 hours ended up staying 5 hours 🍺.Alessandro is super professional, knows what he is doing , and is respectful. I 'd recommend this activity to anyone looking to have fun and meet people. Grazie mile Ale !
Super fun time but the last spot on the crawl could use some work... very young crowd and not all that inviting to our specific group

the barcrawl was simply amazing. we went in with little to no expectation, but went out with the most amazing feeling. Alessandro is an amazing host that includes everyone in a very good way. we had some good drinking games. some good beers and met a lot of new people. well worth the visit if you're coming here to Rome.

Joined this as a solo traveler. Host includes everyone. Easy people to talk to and make friends with from all over. Everyone spoke good English. Bars were fun. There is a decent account of walking to do. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a night out.

Met some dope people from around the world!

Alessandro was amazing! Escopazzo was our favorite bar! Good vibe, Viking was my favorite bartender and we got to pick our own music (we love to dance).

Thank you for having us all the way from Hawai’i, aloha!
So much better then I even expected! So much fun, definitely recommend doing this if you are a solo traveller or with a group. Went to some cool bars & ended at a very fun club. 10/10

An amazing night,

I'd highly recommend this if you are looking to meet new people and want to experience the nightlife in Romé.

Thank you Alessandro for the amazing experience!

Thank you very much Alessandro, we really liked everyone very friendly and social, we met friends from all over the world. Alessandro is a very good host. He always made us feel welcome and safe since there were only two of us girls and everyone was very respectful. They always made you feel very good.
Alessandro was a great time! Highly recommend this tour if you want to meet other travellers and explore nightlife in Rome. Alessandro also helped us track down a lost passport which was a big help!

This was such a fun experience! Alessandro took us to places we wouldn’t have gone otherwise. He always walked around to keep an eye out and made sure everyone felt included. We did a few games & got to meet many new people who were super easy going. The description is just as it says - We went to 3 spots and spent a good amount of time in each of them. Alessandro was a great host. He told us a about himself and asked us about our stories as well. Grab your group of friends. You can’t go wrong booking this!
The bar crawl was so much fun! Alessandro is funny, genuine, and a great host. This was an unforgettable Rome experience that we would gladly do again

Me and my wife had a blast! The host went out of his way to make sure people were making connections and having a good time. The drinks flowed strong and the night went on. Helpful tip though, there is no need to pregame this experience. There will be plenty of alcohol to get the job done.

We had the best time on this bar crawl! Alessandro and his partner made the experience more fun than just going bar to bar. They included everyone and had planned fun games too. This is a great experience to do in Rome to meet fellow travelers and hit some awesome bars. There was also a photographer on the crawl that uploaded really high quality pictures of the night the following day, that was one of the highlights for us! Would highly recommend this experience to everyone.
We had an amazing time with Alessandro! It was lots of fun, he made sure everyone felt included and organised funny games. We made some new friends from all around the world.
We had the best time with Alessandro on the bar crawl. He and his team made sure everyone is safe while having fun. A great way to see Rome nightlife!

As a solo traveler who likes to party and meet new people i had so much fun.Alessandro made sure everyone was having fun and took good care of everybody.Made new friends from around the globe.I definitely recommend this experience

Was such a fun experience and we felt so safe too, Alessandro is so kind and welcoming to everyone. We made new friends from all over the world, and went to places we would have never been to without going. I would definitely recommend!
Amazing time!! Such a great experience! Alessandro is so kind and truly makes you feel welcome! If you are considering you should do it - great way to make friends!
This is something you must do if you want to have fun in Rome. I met cool people from different parts of the world and Alessandro was warm and welcoming

This bar crawl is so fun!!! You meet so many new people, shots at each place is so fun! Even as a solo traveler! If you are looking for a fun night out in Rome! Choose this experience with Alessandro (:
Great experience! If you’re a solo traveller, perfect Oppurtunity to break the ice and meet people from across the globe. It was a fun night 🥳

DO NOT HESITATE! This is the best experience we had in Rome! Alessandro will make you comfortable as soon as you arrive. It’s an activity full of surprises and beautiful encounters. We are all open-minded young tourists who want to have fun. Thanks again Alessandro!

Alessandro delivers a great, fun and exciting program with VIP access and skipping the line to hot spots in Rome. He is thoughtful, considerate and care for the group and that everyone is having a great night! Definitely worth the money and a good way to make friends and learn about the nightlife of Rome. Highly recommended!

Alessandro was a wonderful host for this experience! He made us all feel extremely welcomed and included the entire night. We felt safe and had a blast! I would’ve never found the places he took us to on my own

So much fun! Alessandro made me feel immediately welcomed and checked up on us throughout the night. Made a lot of new friends and memories. Would absolutely recommend booking this, multiple times even!

Alessandro has a great ability to integrate the group, whether you are attending alone or with others. From the beginning, you feel welcome and in the company of friends. The selection of bars allowed us to appreciate Rome at night and understand the nightlife of this city.

If you are travelling solo or with a small group and want to have fun and meet other people in Rome, I highly recommend booking this activity. I came alone and had a great time. Alessandro is a fantastic host. Be prepared for some fun drinking games.

We booked about an hour before the meet up time and we're so happy we did! Alessandro and crew do a fantastic job creating a welcoming and fun environment. If you're on the fence just do it, you will not regret it 😜

Alessandro provided the full Rome nightlife experience! Meeting people from different places and connecting through games, dancing, karaoke and walking along the city streets was so lovely. Alessandro made sure we all were comfortable and felt good. All the spots he brought us to were full of positive people. Eli, Job and Nemo were apart of the bar crawl team and they were all very nice to meet! It was a very pleasurable time ✨
We met new friends and went to bars we probably wouldn't have gone to. The first bar was a sports bar that we were able to watch the Lions game at before the tour started!
The experience is very cool…. Since they speak Spanish and give you a super easy group... there are games and the atmosphere is super good... mega recommended...

Amazing experience! We were running late and Alessandro still tried to make sure we could still catch up with the group.

He remembered our names throughout the experience, and truly went above and beyond to ensure everyone had a safe and fun time.

We felt super welcomed by the hosts and the group and had an amazing last night in Rome

If you are a solo traveler do it! You will not regret it at all Alessandro is always looking out for you and remembers your name which makes me feel so much better. Can’t say enough great things about this experience. I’ve also met amazing new people that I now call friends. Just book it !

Unique and highly recommended experience if you are traveling alone, I met people from all over the world who are also traveling alone in conclusion is amazing, don't be shy when it comes to party friend@.
Great bar crawling to meet friends! Alessandro and his crew were super welcoming and made sure everyone was having fun and no one was left behind! I will definitely do it again!

The bar crawl was fun. I met amazing people who I have stayed in contact with.

Expect to drink and have fun with different age groups.
Alessandro made us feel welcome & we had such a good night !! So fun from the moment you got there, definitely recommend it ☺️☺️

Overall it was a good time. We went to three different places. The biggest issue is that it’s too many people and not enough bartenders so most of the time I was waiting for a drink and not enjoying the partying. The places were all nice tho.

There’s no way you’re going to have a better night than with Alessandro and his bar crawl. He makes sure everyone feels included and has a good time! Made new friends and the clubs he took us to seemed like a whole in the wall and I’m not really sure if I would have even known they existed without signing up for the bar crawl. Worth it. Book it!!
Alessandro was a great host! We made several new friends and got to experience Rome in a fun, unique way! I would highly recommend this to anyone coming to Rome looking for a fun night out
This was my first time in pub crawl and I definitely liked it! Safe and so much fun. Alessandro will make your perfect night for sure! 10/10
What a blast! Alessandro is a wonderful host, and we’re so thankful we signed up for this bar crawl. It was so much fun getting to meet other travelers while exploring Rome’s night life!
Such a fun time! Alessandro made us feel attended to and welcome even with a group of 40 people. The bars were lively and everyone had an amazing time.

This pub crawl was a great way to meet people from around the world. Also a great way to experience the night life in Rome. Alessandro was very kind and attentive to each one of his 50+ guests. It shows how much he cares about delivering a good experience.

This experience was fantastic, having to the opportunity to make friends with people from all over the world. They have connecting games and great hospitality. Definitely would recommend for a social night out in Rome!
I got the chance to meet a lot of cool people from all over the world. I think it's a great experience for solo travelers. The bars were also pretty nice, I had an awesome time!

Had a blast and great time, recommend others to get in on the action of Rome’s best party to offer. Take in Rome’s nightlife like a real Roman with this experience and you won’t be disappointed. Alessandro curates a fantastic night-time affair that will have you on a rip no matter what day of the week (go Tuesdays for the boat party)
Perfect way to meet new people, and have a fun memory lasting experience in Rome.

A fun night of bar crawling in Rome! - Met some pretty cool people in the process. Definitely a nice way to meet others while solo traveling. Also, someone in the group was nice enough to call a cab when I needed to get back to my bnb so late in Rome. Overall it was good experience.
A decent way to meet a few people especially if you are traveling alone. The host, Alessandro, is a super cool guy to talk with and gave some recommendations as well.
Alessandro was a really cool host. He’s been traveling around the world and was able to carry the night amazingly well. Met awesome people and had a blast 🥳

It was a present for my sister and she loved every bit of it. It was a very fun night! We met a lot of new awesome people. Alessandro was a good host. He made you feel welcome and he has a great vibe! Xxx team Holland
Awesome experience. Allessandro was great and made the experience super fun and welcoming! Had a great time meeting a bunch of other travelers.

It is a must! It is such a good night and & great way to meet new people especially if you're solo travelling like myself. Met so many different people from different walks of life. Alessandro was very accommodating to everyone making sure people were okay. The bars we went to were fun & I enjoyed them! All in all I would 100% recommend anyone to do this experience, I had the best night.

It was a fun experience. Our only complaint was it was a lot of walking between bars. The last club was packed and we headed home but we are much older. And it was our third tour of the day. enjoyed the conversations with others from around the world.

The best night out in Rome. Alessandro was an amazing host, very welcoming and always made sure that everyone was alright and enjoying the party. We went to 2 bars and a club. There were plenty of fun drinking games and also karaoke. Just be prepared to pay 10€ for a RedBull vodka in the club. But I would definitely do it again when I visit Rome. It was a great and safe way to meet new people and party. 11/10

I had a wonderful time in both bars and the club last night😁
The host Alessandro was super attentive and he made us feel very save and welcome. He also checked in on us multiple times in the night to make sure we were having a good time. The drinking games at the pub were fun for getting to know the people better (and to get a free drink😉).
Our group was very dynamic and fortunately very talkative. We met some amazing people from all over the world with whom we partied late into the night.

Definetely would reccomend 10/10🥳

I only went to the first bar and left after grabbing a drink. The host is super friendly. I was a bit too tired and didn't connect with anyone so I left early, but it's a great way to meet other travelers!

The experience was great. You get what you paid for. A bit of food and a drink and a shot. The first bar was great, the second bar not so much. What made the second bar great was the location of it. The third bar was much better. Lots of music, had a great time.

It was an amazing night. As two young women who where solo traveling, this was an awesome experience if you want to meet new people and partying at Rome. Alessandro it was a really coool host who encourage us to give the better of us in any momento. 10/10🤌🏼
Im solo traveling and this was a must do! Alessandro takes you to some good bars and you get to meet some fun people. Don’t pass up on this experience.

NO CAP!!! Best party of my trip to Italy.Met some amazing people and had hella fun.
Alessandro and his team were terrific,lovely and welcoming.
I was a bit nervous that it would be awkward, but no!!! So many nice people and a very thoughtful host. It was such a fun night. Would do it again any time!!!!
I had an amazing time! As a solo traveler I was able to meet so many people and experience Rome’s nightlife. Alessandro made sure I was taken care of and meeting new people. I highly recommend!
I had a great time and Alessandro was a great host. I meet a lot of people from all over the world which always is fun!

A really cool experience in Rome. it was nice to go out with a group and see the Roman nightlife. We meet people from all over the world. Alessandro is really organized and had everything thought out from where to go to what to do.

Wow this was insanely fun. We were a huge group and Alessandro coordinated everything so well. We were able to meet a lot of people. Each place we went had great music and great staff that helped out. Everyone was incredibly personable and just full of life! There was a bit of walking but I personally liked it and seeing Rome just lit up at night. And for the price it is ridiculously worth it. The host definitely made it one night to remember (: My friends and I had the best night. It exceeded my expectations (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) .

I loved it! I traveled to Rome alone, so it was a good idea to go on my first night to this experience, as I made several friends with whom I kept exploring the city, so I highly recommend it is a good way to start socializing and find your partner in crime in this beautiful city 😉

Had a top night out on this bar crawl! Great way to meet new people as a solo traveller and have a few drinks. Alessandro was a hero and made sure all of the solo travellers were introduced to everyone so we all felt part of the group. He also sent round some recommendations for things to do in Rome which was a nice touch!

I had a really fun night at the bar crawl! I was a little apprehensive at the beginning as it was a large group of about 30 or 40 on a friday night and many were quite rowdy (a proper party crowd). I myself normally prefer smaller more intimate groups myself, but I was quickly able to find my type of people among the crowd! I had a lot of fun, Alessandro watched out for us and was super nice, there was loads of great people watching, and I made friends with people I was able to hang out with for the rest of my solo trip - which was my primary reason for booking!
A great experience if you want to meet like minded travelers and see the wild side of Rome. The host is lovely and made everyone feel special 😊

Alessandro was a great host, me and my wife chose this tour to celebrate our birthdays and it was a great experience. We met new friends and had a blast at each bar we went too. Definitely recommend this tour.
BEST NIGHT EVER. Book right now. Alessandro IS amazing. The entire night was so memorable. The people, music, drinks, dancing and atmosphere was 10/10. I would do it again and again.
Highly recommend Alessandro. He is very attentive. We visited 2 Irish pubs and ended up at a club some where in Rome. The night was a bit blurry but definitely fun.

I’m so glad I signed up. I was a bit skeptical because it was a weekday but the turnout was super massive. I enjoyed the bar hopping experience and met so many different people as well. Alessandro is the man, for shizzle.

This was the most original tour in a very pleasant company. The bar reveals the real culture and atmosphere of Rome. Of course you must visit this place if you like communication and night walks. In one evening, your team traveling to the bars of Rome will be your second family. I just wanted to say hi and let you know how much I enjoyed staying at our Alessandro tour guide. He's a passionate travel enthusiast, and he knows how to bring people together.
This was a great night out for my sister and I! Alessandro was an awesome host & we felt safe the whole time. We made new friends we’re excited to see again!

We had a great time !
At first we had thought, as we thought we would be by far the youngest at the age of 18, but that did not matter at all.
Everyone was super open and we were very well welcomed into the group.
The vibe was also really great, even if the music at the second venue might have been a bit international.
We can definitely recommend the experience!!!

The experience was extremely fun. Alessandro was nice enough to wait for people to arrive or someone else and welcoming everyone into the meeting point. Greeting you and introducing you to everyone that has already arrived.
Punctual and informative and friendly.
What you pay is all that you need to pay unless you are ordering something extra. But all entry to all places is covered and drinks as well.
Everyone that attends this experience is friendly and sociable. So dont be afraid or shy to spark a conversation with someone.
I personally have made a few friends out of this and would do this again if i were staying longer in Rome.

My wife and I did this experience on a whim. If we’re being honest we were second guessing going because by 9pm we were already so tired from our day but we decided it’s vacation time so we need to push through and we are so glad we did. We had one of the best nights of our lives. Also, we enjoyed all the free welcome shots !! We met so many cool people and went to nice bars/clubs. Although there is a lot of walking in between the different locations we really didn’t mind it. Totally a must do if your looking for nightlife in Rome. We would 100% do it again. Thank you Alessandro for giving us a night we won’t forget!!

My wife and I signed up for this bar crawl on our last night in Rome. Alessandro was a great host, very attentive and personable. Got to meet some pretty cool people from around the world. The bars we went to played great music and great vibes overall. We had a great night! Highly recommended !

My boyfriend and I booked this for our last night and Rome and are so happy we did!
Alessandro is super nice and we met some awesome people from around the world. I was a worried because we booked on a Sunday but the turnout was great and there were so many people!
Great experience to meet people from all around the world and hang in different local bars. Alessandro is an amazing person, was always there making sure all people were connecting and having fun!

Alessandro is attentive and cares about making sure you’re having a good time. Checked in on us multiple times, and made us feel welcome. That said, the event felt more college age with lots of guys. If you’re looking for that, this is excellent!
Did it my first night in Rome. Great way to meet people, and get a feel of where to go for the rest of your time there.

This bar crawl is so much fun and Alessandro is very welcoming to everyone! It was my friends birthday and first time in Rome and she felt extremely special. Cannot thank Alessandro enough for being a great guide and creating such an awesome environment.
I had a lot of fun. In the meeting point we played fun drinking games and I met 2 new friends. Kinda wished the club we ended at played better music but that didn’t make the experience bad.

Very nice experience. I would recommend this. It was great to meet other people from different countries. Alessandro was really nice person and gave recommendations where to visit in Rome, that made it even better 😄

It was sooo much fun, we played a lot of fun games (where you can even win something)! We met a lot of great people there and made new friends. We went to three different locations, which where all really amazing, with some good music!! Me and my friend would definitely recommend it!!

The experience was great and our host was even better!
Our host Alessandro had games prepared as soon as we got to the meet up location and created an environment that was great for socializing. All locations that we stopped by were walking distance which was great also. I had an amazing time for my first night out in Rome. I recommend this 100% for anyone who wants to break the ice in going out in Rome.

Alessandro is great! Very friendly, smiling and entrepreneurial, he won't let you get bored or isolated. Had a great evening.
Thank you!😁

Beautiful experience, also perfect for solo travelers. Alessandro and the staff are very kind and make you feel at ease from the start.
I recommend it!
Alessandro has a couple people helping him out to keep track of everyone and get everyone to the next stop. They took great care of us, and were very friendly! Very well organized tour :)
Highly recommended to everyone! Alessandro, is a great host, it was over all expectations))) I had a lot of fun in these club and local bars which you won't find by yourself. Definitely worth it!

We had a great time with Alessandro, we've made a lot of friends and had a great time.
I definetely recommend this to anyone who wants to enjoy their night in Rome :)

The night was amazing. Alessandro has thought everything very well and is a very likeable, cool and open person. We stayed in several bars, had some good drinks and always a nice view. I especially liked the bar on the river, and the beer pong was cool at the first bar! After that we went on a boat, with also a beautiful view! Lastly, there was an afterparty at a club/bar. We'll be home around 4: 30, but there was still a lot going on at the club.
I'm really happy to have taken the event! We met super cool people (we were about 30 people in total, so a large group). Gladly next time we are in Rome again!

🥰🥳🍻Thanks again for everything Alessandro!

If you want to unwind after a busy day exploring Rome, this is just for you. Alessandro is the most amazing host you will ever meet, he takes care of you like he knows you for years. He guided us with everything and helped us with getting back too.
The experience was so refreshing and we made new friends. The places we went for really good. Highly recommend !!
I traveled solo to Rome and wanted to go out so I joined this experience. Hands down best decision I made! It was so much fun and I made lots of friends!

I had such a fun time! Met the greatest people and made me feel at home in Rome. Alessandro was a great host and made sure everyone felt involved and was having a good time. Would do this all over again!

Great way to explore some local bars, you get tickets for drinks, 2 regulars and a shot. For $26, as well as an opportunity to mingle with other tourists (not everyone is coming from Airbnb, some people just sign up as they go into the bar), so big crowd =always lit bars.
